stem: After the 1954 Geneva Conference, which action became a part of U.S. foreign policy?

options.label: A
options.text: The gradual buildup of financial and military aid to South Vietnam

options.label: B
options.text: The gradual buildup of economic and industrial aid to North Vietnam

options.label: C
options.text: The use of diplomatic efforts to reunify Cambodia and South Vietnam

options.label: D
options.text: The use of military force to restore French rule in Laos and North Vietnam
